corrections.why: The 93 call-ready of 115 dialable was counted on 2026-10-31 (commit e986c45) under the instrument as it then stood: a row was call-ready if it carried a phone or email and any date anywhere in its Address source, Notes or Decision-maker text — a date that may date something else entirely. Item 321’s fix (2026-10-31) replaced that with the rule now in force: a contact is dated only by a dated source that sources the contact itself.
